title: Quaker Faith & Practice
altTitles: Church Government in the Religious Society of Friends
attributionNote: A compilation by Britain Yearly Meeting, largely made up of extracts from named Friends across history. It is not a universal Quaker scripture, and other yearly meetings maintain different books of discipline.
description: Quaker Faith & Practice sets out the discipline, advices, queries, procedures and selected readings of Britain Yearly Meeting. It is a living book, revised over time, and its extracts carry their own authors and historical contexts.
historicalContext: The book descends from earlier Quaker disciplines and was substantially reshaped in the twentieth century. The fifth edition is the current Britain Yearly Meeting text, also available online and in print.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. QFP is copyrighted and no reuse licence was found. The QFP copyright contact is publications@quaker.org.uk.
